ai.title: India's hospital sector enters new growth cycle as AI and capacity expansion reshape care: Report
ai.description: The Indian hospital sector is poised for a sustained expansion over the next decade, driven by structural demand and a fresh investment cycle, according to a research report by brokerage firm Miare Asset Sharekhan. After years of balance-sheet repair and measured growth, listed chains are now accelerating capacity additions, signaling a shift from ARPOB-led profitability to volume-driven growth. With private insurance penetration rising and an acute bed shortage persisting, the industry is set to attract long-term capital even beyond FY30, the report said.
